title: Velocity-matched transitions and keyframe overlap
what_it_does: Rules plus GSAP templates for zoom-through, directional and other cuts that keep speed across the seam, and overlapping stages of one element's motion so there is no dead frame.
when_to_use: Smooth scene changes and entrance chains.
why: This is the nearest thing to our carry helper and is written for HyperFrames. Read it against ours before deciding which wins; the overlap rule (no dead frame between two stages) is the new part.
